name: Camping Stein
beschreibung: The campsite Camping Stein is situated in Bad Endorf in the Chiemgau region. Embedded in an expansive parkland setting, it features scenic pitches for motorhomes, caravans and tents. A private on-site lake offers refreshing swimming opportunities, complemented by a welcoming restaurant and kiosk. The location provides easy access to Lake Chiemsee and the mountains, with the local area celebrated for its soothing thermal springs.
